pageDescription: Enterprise website development with Craft CMS and Next.js for the Fidium family of websites.
fbOgSiteName: A Fort Worth based developer who makes unique web experiences.
workHeroImageAlt: Family playing video games together on a couch at home
workDescription: At Amdocs, I work on the enterprise website platform for Fidium Fiber, Business, Wholesale, Partners and Consolidated Communications, using Craft CMS, Next.js and React.
workNarrative: My work includes CMS development, page-building tools, GraphQL integration and shared React components, along with testing and documentation.
I also support maintenance and deployments across development, QA, staging and production, working with engineering, marketing, IT and cloud teams.
workHighlights: Built the headless Craft CMS (bespoke editor, GraphQL, custom modules) that serves content for 7 sites.
Redesigned and launched Next.js apps for Fidium Fiber, Business, Partners, Wholesale, Consolidated and fidium.net.
Maintained a shared UI toolkit of components, hooks and webhooks, tested with Jest and documented in Storybook.
Configured Nginx reverse proxies to serve several sites from one repo, across dev, QA, stage and production on GitLab CI/CD.
workRole: Software Engineer, Lead Craft CMS Developer, React/Next.js Developer
workTechnology: Craft CMS, Payload CMS, Next.js, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Storybook, Jest, Nginx, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Amazon Web Services (SES, S3, RDS)
